prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a complete polished desktop homepage screenshot for fictional Korean industrial automation company HANGYEOL, 1024x1536 portrait. This is a premium 2026 website concept, not a mood board. Use a white navigation header, Korean copy, crisp contemporary sans typography, pure white non-photo surfaces, one blue accent, restrained arrows. Realistic clean industrial photography only where requested. Keep sections spacious and cardless: editorial columns, image blocks, rules, lists. No colored section bands, no gray/beige tinted backgrounds, no dark footer, no statistics dashboard, no logo cloud, no pill soup, no generic SaaS UI, no fake 3D gradients. Make all layout possible with React and Tailwind CSS, with Lucide-style icons. Exact useful labels: 회사소개, 제품소개, 산업솔루션, 구축사례, 기술지원, 문의하기. Concept A — INDUSTRIAL MONOGRAPH. Treat the page like an architecture monograph. Header has a small black HANGYEOL wordmark at far left and quiet nav. Hero is full-bleed edge-to-edge photograph of a bright, immaculate automated production line with strong vanishing point; no human in hero. Place one short white headline low in the photograph: "생산의 기준을 다시 설계합니다" and one compact solid blue CTA. Below hero on white, a huge two-line black statement aligned left with one short paragraph aligned to the right. Then one oversized horizontal case photograph with a thin caption and arrow. Next, a text-led product index of four rows where each row has a product name, one sentence, and a small right arrow; no product cards. End with a clean contact line and compact footer. Keep the first viewport like a magazine cover, with no split-screen hero and no dense grids.
